claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised, as the retired champion of the world, to appear at a boxing entertainment at Flannigan's Hall, East St. Louis, on March 29, 1883, which was not held.
claims.excerpt:
two veterans Tom Allen, the retired cham-
pion of the world, and Tom Kelly

claims.statement: Tom Allen was described as the retired champion of the world.
claims.excerpt:
two veterans Tom Allen, the retired cham-

notes: Allen appears only in the printed poster. The article does not say he was in East St. Louis or that he refused; the cancellation is attributed to Tom Kelly. The Illinois law and the mayor's proclamation are not about Allen.
